name: roadmap-smoke-lots
description: Turn docs/ROADMAP.md into parent-owned, smoke-first execution lots with explicit blockers and oracle gates.

stages.name: map-roadmap-items
stages.expectedOutcome: Extract unchecked roadmap items, prerequisites, blockers, and smoke-first lot candidates from one roadmap artifact.
stages.promptTemplate: Analyze roadmap item {item.id} at {item.path}. Map unchecked roadmap work into smoke-first lots. Separate safe-now slices from blocked batch/router/daemon/browser/write-adapter work. Return literal_request, actual_need, success_looks_like, files, answer, gaps, next_steps, evidence, risks/blockers, compliance, and deliverable_delivered.
mustDo: Read the roadmap artifact before conclusions.
Cite roadmap sections and unchecked items as evidence.
Prefer smoke-first lots with deterministic validation artifacts.
mustNotDo: No daemon, pilot, batch, model-router, or browser/write-adapter execution.
stages.context: Factory {factory.name} run {run.id}; map stage for {item.id} at {item.path}. Outputs directory: {outputs.dir}.

stages.name: reduce-prioritize-lots
stages.expectedOutcome: Prioritize roadmap lots into an execution queue with prerequisites, oracle gates, and blocked items.
stages.promptTemplate: Synthesize roadmap lot map outputs for factory {factory.name} run {run.id}. Read outputs from {outputs.dir}. Produce consensus, conflicts, missing_evidence, recommended_next_action, tasks_to_rerun, evidence, risks/blockers, compliance, and deliverable_delivered. Prioritize safe smoke-first lots before gated pilot/batch/router/daemon work.
mustDo: Keep parent-owned preflight and oracle gates explicit.
Recommend the next single smoke slice only.
mustNotDo: No edits outside the run directory.
No autonomy, daemon, pilot, batch, or router activation.

stages.name: validate-roadmap-lots
stages.expectedOutcome: Validate roadmap factory outputs and produce PASS/FAIL/WARN with no_ship decision.
stages.promptTemplate: Validate factory {factory.name} run {run.id}. Check manifest, outputs, checkpoints, validation.json, final-report.md, telemetry.json, and DONE.sentinel under {run.dir}. Return verdict, confidence, no_ship, blockers, notes, evidence, merged_lanes, risks/blockers, compliance, and deliverable_delivered.
mustDo: Fail if sentinel or validation evidence is missing.
Warn if blocked roadmap items are treated as ready-to-run.
mustNotDo: No daemon, pilot, batch, model-router, or browser/write-adapter execution.
